title: [GMCP 203.003.04] Adversarial and failure behavior: Modern stateless lifecycle and server discovery
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-003-04. Close validation, authorization, isolation, privacy, bounded-resource, cancellation, concurrency, crash, retry, rollback, and recovery behavior. Add deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures derived from the vector threat model. Vector outcome: For MCP 2026-07-28 and later GMCP is genuinely stateless at the protocol layer: no initialize ceremony or session identifier is required, every request carries and validates version plus client capabilities, every result identifies the server, server/discover is complete and cacheable, and explicit handles bind all cross-call state. Concurrent requests from changing clients cannot leak negotiated state. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
